claim_entries.value: the artifacts and field traces support the claim's bounded feasibility scope because the paper explicitly includes instructor/researcher assistance; they do not establish independent performance, learning gains, or generalisation. (PDF pp. 10–11)
quotes: "It became clear that instructors and researchers would need to take a larger role in writing code examples and directing learner progress." (p. 10)
"danceON enabled two cohorts of novice programmers to code and successfully complete original artistic projects in under two weeks with assistance from the instructor and researchers." (p. 11)

paper_code_entries.value: culturally responsive creative-computing education through dance and body-data animation. (PDF p. 2)
quotes: "danceON (dance Object Notation) is an educationally-focused programming system for creating visual animations that respond to data from body movement." (p. 2)

paper_code_entries.value: both — computing-literacy development and completion of expressive computational artifacts. (PDF p. 2)
quotes: "Our shared goal is to engage young women of color in creating artistic computational artifacts within culturally relevant dance learning experiences." (p. 2)

paper_code_entries.value: novice_or_learner (PDF p. 11)
quotes: "danceON enabled two cohorts of novice programmers to code and successfully complete original artistic projects in under two weeks with assistance from the instructor and researchers." (p. 11)

paper_code_entries.value: execution_or_skill_gap — learners had domain ideas but faced the dual burden of translating them into computation while learning the language and its execution model. (PDF p. 3)
quotes: "Beginner programmers must do this translation into computational form while simultaneously learning the programming language, paradigm, and notional machine that they are attempting to use [24]." (p. 3)

paper_code_entries.value: process — observations, code, and working documents were analyzed. (PDF p. 11)
quotes: "We draw from observation notes, learner project videos, code, and working documents to identify successes and limitations of the current danceON prototype and deployment with respect to our initial four design goals." (p. 11)

paper_code_entries.value: artifact — four teams produced themed performance videos with original choreography and coded animations. (PDF p. 9)
quotes: "Four teams of four-to-six learners created performance videos." (p. 9)

paper_code_entries.value: structuring — the language organizes an animation into constrained what, where, when, and how properties. (PDF p. 7)
quotes: "using the keywords what, where, when, and how" (p. 7)

paper_code_entries.value: problematizing — the Skeleton overlay makes missing and inaccurate sensed data visible. (PDF p. 6)
quotes: "The Skeleton overlay also clearly exposes inaccurate and missing data." (p. 6)

paper_code_entries.value: contingency — rendered feedback changes with the learner's current code and active body/video state. (PDF p. 6)
quotes: "Both cases constitute live coding as programs render immediately and react to changes in the active media." (p. 6)

paper_code_entries.value: adaptation — instructors and researchers created recipes in response to learner discussions and planned ideas. (PDF p. 9)
quotes: "Instructors and researchers created new code segments" (p. 9)

paper_code_entries.value: distributed_support — project completion depended on the IDE, examples, instructors, and researchers rather than a single support source. (PDF p. 11)
quotes: "instructors and researchers provided ample support to learners" (p. 11)

paper_code_entries.value: non_generative_ai — PoseNet/OpenPose estimate body-part coordinates and a user-trained classifier can trigger animations. (PDF pp. 5–6)
quotes: "Pose estimation in danceON uses the open source computer vision libraries PoseNet" (p. 5)
"trigger animations on poses" (p. 6)

paper_code_entries.value: pre_llm_ai — the semantic assistance comes from pre-LLM computer-vision pose estimation and classification. (PDF pp. 5–6)
quotes: "PoseNet runs in the web" (p. 5)
"danceON also integrates with Teachable Machine" (p. 6)
